items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: She played with a bar neck on her finger just like Freddie McDowell do.

ctx.x: So, and, uh, this lady, uh, they called her, uh, she, she wore her hair just like a man with a brace back, you know. Texas. They called it Texas. They had a play with Annie Allison one night and that woman could do more with a guitar and a monkey could with a coconut. She could. That woman could play in there. And so, she was there for the play that night. Henry Gaines walked in and he asked her, let me play with you. She told him, come out. She played with a bar neck on her finger just like Freddie McDowell do.…
Well, that woman taking that guitar there.
